name: map
description: Spec-to-bead correlation layer. Owns the mapping file (.bead-map.json) that links spec node IDs to bead IDs. Provides CRUD operations, context resolution, and CLI query interface.

requirements.title: Store mapping records
requirements.description: Read/write .bead-map.json. Each record links a spec node ID to a bead ID with structured metadata: module name, component/section name, content file path, spec hash at time of mapping, and bead type.

requirements.title: Query mappings via CLI
requirements.description: spex map get <record-id> returns structured JSON with module, component, content path, and metadata. spex map list shows all mappings. spex map context <record-id> resolves full spec context.

requirements.title: Validate mapping file against schema
requirements.description: MappingStore validates .bead-map.json against the bead-map JSON Schema on load. Invalid files produce a clear error before any CRUD operation.

requirements.title: Resolve full spec context from record
requirements.description: Given a record ID, deterministically resolve all spec files needed to implement the component: architecture file (from record content_file), impl_sections whose describes array contains the component ID, test_sections whose describes array contains the component ID, and data_flows whose uses array contains the component ID. Returns a single JSON blob with all file paths.

components.name: MappingStore
components.description: Read/write .bead-map.json. CRUD operations on mapping records. Each record links a spec node ID to a bead ID with structured metadata including bead_type field. Supports record updates for obsolete+create flows.

components.name: MapCommand
components.description: CLI entry point for spex map. Wires MappingStore and ContextResolver to serve queries and context resolution.

components.name: ContextResolver
components.description: Given a mapping record, reads the module.json and resolves all spec files for the component: arch, impl_sections, test_sections, and data_flows. Pure function over spec directory — deterministic and cacheable.

data_flows.name: Bead creation mapping flow
data_flows.description: When Apply creates a bead, it calls MappingStore to create a mapping record. The record ID is stored as the bead label. Skills query mappings via MapCommand.
